title: Rav Ada son of Rav Chinena or Chanina
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Nedarim 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.22b.3), in an aggadic matter; Hyman reports that in [Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20](https://www.sefaria.org/Bamidbar_Rabbah.4.20) he is mentioned as Rav Ada bar Chanina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Bavli calls him Rav Ada beRabbi Chanina. Bamidbar Rabbah has Rabbi Ada bar Rabbi Chanina.
Hyman’s heading gives Rav before the father’s name and preserves both forms, Chinena and Chanina.
